critical_issues.description: Pages marked with 'use client' cannot export metadata directly. Metadata should be moved to corresponding layout.tsx files or generateMetadata() should be used.
critical_issues.impact: Search engines cannot read title tags and meta descriptions properly. Pages may not rank for target keywords.
critical_issues.solution: Create layout.tsx files with metadata exports for each client component page

critical_issues.issue: Title Tags Not Optimized for Local SEO
critical_issues.description: Many pages missing location modifiers in titles. Homepage title is generic. Service pages don't include 'Brisbane' or 'Ipswich' in titles.
critical_issues.current_example: Emergency Restoration Brisbane | IICRC Master Restorer | 1300 309 361
critical_issues.recommended: Water Damage Restoration Brisbane, Ipswich, Logan | Master Restorer Phill McGurk | 1300 309 361
critical_issues.impact: Reduced visibility for location-based searches. Missing high-volume local keywords.
critical_issues.solution: Add location modifiers to all titles. Include primary keyword at start. Add power words like 'Emergency', '24/7', 'Master Restorer'.
critical_issues.estimated_impact: HIGH - 30% traffic increase potential with proper location targeting

critical_issues.description: Cache-Control header set to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' preventing search engines from caching pages effectively.
critical_issues.current_config: Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, proxy-revalidate, max-age=0
critical_issues.impact: Search engines may crawl less frequently. Page speed scores reduced. CDN caching disabled.
critical_issues.solution: Implement appropriate caching strategy for static pages while allowing dynamic emergency content updates.

critical_issues.description: Homepage has no detectable H1 tag in server-rendered HTML. H1 tags rendered client-side are invisible to crawlers initially.
critical_issues.current_state: H1 tags exist in JSX but not in initial HTML payload
critical_issues.recommended: Use server components for critical content or implement SSR for H1 tags
critical_issues.impact: Search engines cannot identify primary page topic. Reduced keyword relevance signals.
critical_issues.solution: Convert critical sections to server components or use Next.js metadata to inject H1 in initial HTML
critical_issues.estimated_impact: HIGH - H1 is crucial ranking factor

critical_issues.description: Main location pages (Brisbane, Ipswich, Logan) appear to be missing. Only suburb pages exist (Hamilton, Ascot, etc.).
critical_issues.impact: Missing opportunity to rank for high-volume keywords like 'water damage restoration Brisbane' on dedicated location pages.
critical_issues.solution: Create comprehensive city-level pages with 1500+ words covering all services, suburbs, response times, local knowledge.

high_priority_issues.description: Many pages use generic descriptions. Not enough unique, compelling CTAs with phone number and emergency keywords.
high_priority_issues.current_example: Phill McGurk - IICRC Master Restorer. 60-min emergency response Brisbane.
high_priority_issues.recommended: Brisbane water damage? Master Restorer arrives in 60 min! 24/7 emergency water extraction, flood recovery, burst pipes. All insurers approved. Call 1300 309 361 now - Hamilton, Ascot, Ipswich, Logan.
high_priority_issues.solution: Write unique 150-160 character descriptions for each page with location keywords, urgency, and phone number

high_priority_issues.issue: Deep URL Nesting on Some Pages
high_priority_issues.description: Some URLs are deeply nested reducing crawl efficiency and keyword clarity
high_priority_issues.recommended: Keep URLs to 2-3 levels maximum. Consider: /emergency/water-damage-checklist
high_priority_issues.impact: Reduced crawl depth. Longer URLs have lower CTR. Less keyword prominence.
high_priority_issues.solution: Flatten URL structure where possible. Use shorter, keyword-rich slugs.

high_priority_issues.issue: Missing Descriptive Alt Text on Hero Images
high_priority_issues.description: Hero image alt text is too long (150+ words) and keyword-stuffed. Should be concise and descriptive.
high_priority_issues.current_example: Emergency Water Damage Restoration Brisbane by IICRC Master Restorer Phill McGurk - 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, and storm damage across Brisbane, Ipswich, and Logan - 60-minute arrival guarantee
high_priority_issues.recommended: Master Restorer emergency water damage restoration Brisbane - 60-minute response
high_priority_issues.solution: Limit alt text to 125 characters. Focus on primary keyword and action. Avoid keyword stuffing.
high_priority_issues.estimated_impact: MEDIUM - Better image SEO and accessibility

high_priority_issues.description: Service pages don't consistently link to related services or location pages. Missing hub-spoke structure.
high_priority_issues.impact: Reduced PageRank flow. Poor user navigation between related services.
high_priority_issues.solution: Add 'Related Services' section to all service pages. Link service pages to relevant location pages. Create internal linking hub structure.
high_priority_issues.estimated_impact: MEDIUM - Better PageRank distribution and user engagement

high_priority_issues.description: No review/rating schema implemented. Missing opportunity for rich snippets with star ratings.
high_priority_issues.impact: No star ratings in search results. Lower CTR compared to competitors with reviews.
high_priority_issues.solution: Implement AggregateRating schema once genuine reviews are collected. Add Review schema for individual testimonials.
high_priority_issues.estimated_impact: HIGH - Star ratings can increase CTR by 30%+

medium_priority_issues.description: Multiple pages targeting same keywords without clear differentiation
medium_priority_issues.solution: Differentiate pages clearly: Service pages = comprehensive info. Emergency pages = urgent response/booking focused. Add unique modifiers.

medium_priority_issues.description: Some CTA buttons may not meet 44x44px minimum on mobile
medium_priority_issues.solution: Audit all interactive elements for minimum 44x44px touch targets. Add appropriate padding.
medium_priority_issues.estimated_impact: LOW - Better mobile UX and Core Web Vitals

medium_priority_issues.description: Heavy use of framer-motion and client components increases bundle size
medium_priority_issues.current_state: Multiple animation libraries loaded on every page
medium_priority_issues.solution: Code-split animations. Lazy load framer-motion. Consider server components for static content.
medium_priority_issues.estimated_impact: MEDIUM - Improved LCP and FCP scores

medium_priority_issues.issue: Missing FAQ Sections on Some Service Pages
medium_priority_issues.description: Not all service pages have FAQ sections with schema markup
medium_priority_issues.solution: Add service-specific FAQs to all major service pages. Implement FAQ schema for rich snippets.
medium_priority_issues.estimated_impact: MEDIUM - FAQ rich snippets increase visibility
